assumption_to_test: A three-entity activation, observation, and rollback chain is sufficient to make the transition auditable without executing deployment.
smallest_testable_validation: Extend qif-ledger schema, example, verifier, and negative fixtures with one blocked activation and one rollback-complete path derived from the v0.8.6 preview.
expected_learning: Whether authorization, observation, stop, and rollback invariants are structurally reproducible and remain non-authoritative.
success_threshold: Positive example passes; retained negative fixtures reject missing authority, insufficient preview, stale evidence, absent observation, invalid continuation, and incomplete rollback.
